project.title: Integrated Employment Readiness Pathway for Vulnerable Clients
project.objective: Design and pilot a structured pathway that supports vulnerable adults from initial assessment through skills building to sustained employment.
deliverables: End-to-end employment readiness pathway description and flow
Standardised holistic assessment and care planning templates
Operational protocol for coordination between social work, health, and logistics support
Monitoring and incident reporting framework for client moves and workplace transitions
constraints: Pilot must be designed and ready to launch within 21 days
All tools must comply with social care and data protection regulations
Materials must be accessible for clients with disabilities and low digital literacy
Pathway must work with existing community partners and funding limits
Staff training time is limited to short sessions embedded in normal shifts

risks.risk: Low client engagement with the new pathway and workshops.
risks.mitigation: Co-design elements with a small client group, use simple language, and gather quick feedback after each session to adjust content.

risks.risk: Coordination gaps between social workers, employment support workers, healthcare assistants, and movers.
risks.mitigation: Define clear handover points, shared checklists, and a single shared case summary document for each client.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with privacy and safeguarding standards when sharing client information.
risks.mitigation: Create explicit data-sharing rules, anonymise data in tracking sheets, and include a privacy checklist in the protocol.

risks.risk: Physical or emotional stress for clients during relocation or first days in work placements.
risks.mitigation: Healthcare assistant to pre-screen clients, movers to follow a safe-move checklist, and social workers to schedule follow-up wellbeing checks.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures social, health, and employment needs are captured before planning interventions.
Social workers, employment support, health, and movers must align to avoid gaps in support.
Pathway must protect vulnerable adults and respect autonomy and privacy at all stages.
Materials and processes must work for clients with disabilities, language barriers, or low literacy.
Need simple metrics and feedback loops to refine the pilot and justify scaling.

backlog.task: Map current client journey from referral to employment and identify gaps
definition_of_done: Visual map of current journey created
At least 10 recent cases reviewed for patterns
Top 5 recurring gaps and pain points documented
Shared with team for validation in channel

backlog.task: Design holistic assessment and employment readiness template
definition_of_done: Template covers social, health, skills, and employment goals
Privacy and consent section included
Reviewed by employment support worker and healthcare assistant
Template stored in shared drive and linked in channel

backlog.task: Create employment readiness workshop outline and session plans
definition_of_done: 3–4 core workshop sessions defined with objectives
Activities adapted for mixed literacy and language needs
Feedback form for clients drafted
Outline approved by social worker representative

backlog.task: Define health and wellbeing screening process for clients entering the pathway
definition_of_done: Short screening checklist drafted for physical and mental health flags
Referral triggers to clinical services documented
Process aligns with organisational health protocols
Shared with social workers for integration into assessment

backlog.task: Develop safe relocation and workplace transition checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist covers home moves and first commute to workplace
Includes steps to protect client dignity and belongings
Reviewed by social worker for safeguarding aspects
Piloted on at least one mock or real move and adjusted

backlog.task: Draft inter-team coordination protocol and handover points
definition_of_done: Key stages and responsible roles defined
Standard handover notes template created
Escalation path for crises documented
Protocol agreed by all roles in the team

backlog.task: Prepare client-facing information pack about the pathway
definition_of_done: Plain-language leaflet text drafted
Includes rights, consent, and what to expect
Checked for accessibility and translated summary where needed
Approved by social worker for accuracy

backlog.task: Set up simple outcome and attendance tracking sheet for the pilot
definition_of_done: Sheet tracks attendance, milestones, and employment outcomes
Client identifiers pseudonymised
Tested with sample data for clarity
Shared with team and instructions documented

backlog.task: Define safeguarding and incident reporting flow for the pathway
definition_of_done: Types of incidents and thresholds defined
Reporting steps and timelines documented
Aligned with organisational safeguarding policy
Team briefed asynchronously in channel

backlog.task: Plan and schedule staff micro-training sessions on the new pathway
definition_of_done: Key topics and learning objectives listed
Short sessions scheduled within existing shifts
Attendance tracking method agreed
Session invites and materials shared in channel

backlog.task: Identify and confirm 3–5 community employers for pilot placements
definition_of_done: List of potential employers compiled
Basic expectations and support needs discussed
At least 3 employers confirm interest
Summary of each employer profile documented

backlog.task: Prepare pilot evaluation plan and feedback collection approach
definition_of_done: Key success indicators defined
Client and staff feedback tools drafted
Timeline for mid-pilot and end-pilot review set
Plan shared and agreed in channel

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current journey map, key gaps, and overall pathway design.
threads_plan.trigger: After initial draft of the current client journey and first pathway sketch are shared.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the main stages of the new employment readiness pathway.
Confirm top 3 priority gaps to address in the pilot design.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalise assessment, health screening, and safeguarding tools.
threads_plan.trigger: When drafts of the assessment template, health checklist, and safeguarding flow are posted.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the holistic assessment template and consent checklist for pilot use.
Agree on the safeguarding and incident reporting flow across roles.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Shape the workshop programme and client-facing information pack.
threads_plan.trigger: Once the first version of workshop outline and client info pack are uploaded.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock the structure and topics of the employment readiness workshops.
Sign off the client-facing information pack for distribution.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on logistics for moves, workplace transitions, and employer engagement.
threads_plan.trigger: After safe move checklist and initial employer list are shared.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the safe relocation and workplace transition checklist.
Confirm the initial set of employers to include in the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up tracking, evaluation, and team rituals for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: When the outcome tracker and evaluation plan drafts are available.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the key indicators and data to track during the pilot.
Confirm the cadence and format of check-ins and reviews.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async standup where each role posts yesterday-today-blockers focused on the pilot.
Weekly checkpoint thread to review progress against backlog tasks and adjust priorities.
Post-incident mini-reviews in-channel whenever a safeguarding or move-related issue occurs.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and improvement ideas.
Rolling Q&A thread for clarifying use of new templates, checklists, and protocols.
